title: CLR/59/2008 of BHUSHAN NANGIA Vs M/S SUNIL KUMAR VIRENDER KUMAR

paras.text:
CLR No. 59 of 2008
Hon. Prafulla C. Pant, J.

Mr. Ajay Veer Pundir, Advocate present for the revisionist.
Mr. Bhupendra Singh, Advocate present for the respondents.
Learned counsel for the revisionist states that in view of the amicable
settlement between the parties he does not want to press the revision, and he
seeks that he may be permitted to withdraw the revision.
The prayer is allowed.
The revision stands dismissed as withdrawn.
(P.C. P., J.)
 04.11.2009
HN
